links.label: its rule makes the comparison loop

forward_vector: I am the manifest of the pm recipe's rich face, its first round at Sketch tier: one made piece that cooks the recipe exactly as written and walks up to a blind test of its felt claim, "pm sounds still", with its chance and verdict rule set before the first trial and the page's own words named as the leak, with the fingerprint of the words it was laid against and the offers its engine measured for the text. The page is a bundle note with no frontmatter, so I am keyed by its file name, recipe-pm. I never hold the recipe's words.
grain: The page's own ## grain: six sections; one carries a piece (What you should hear). The opening, Ingredients and Where to break it carry offers only; the break's numbers are in the piece's engine and its workshop check, not in a piece of its own.

offers.section: Recipe — Cooking pm into a rhythmic phrase
offers.what: "No rotation" (:3) can't hold on one voice. The Method's mirror, n → 17 − n, is also the half-turn about the seam between 8 and 9. It is the same formula (an identity, true of all 126 cooked loops), so every pm loop has the strip's half-turn too. recipe-p2's face measured the same coincidence from the other side, where "no mirror axis" fails. One possible fix: "Translation plus reflection. On one line of hits, a mirror in time and a half-turn about the same point are one move; pm and p2 come apart only with a second voice." Decide it with recipe-p2's Method offer: the two are one rewrite.

The "Or" line (:12) is not a second choice. On a loop, the mirror n → 17 − n has two ends: the seam between 8 and 9 and the seam between 16 and 1. So "the mirror at the start" is the same mirror seen from its other end (an identity, all 126). Proposed: "The same mirror has a second end, at the start of the cycle between 16 and 1: on a loop, every mirror has two."

"pm patterns sound heavier, more settled, than p2 or p3" (:25) sets pm against a p3 that has mirrors too. recipe-p3's face finds a mirror on every loop its Method can cook, 10 of 10, so the p3 half of the contrast is a mirror against a mirror. The p2 half is what this piece tests blind, on the same half under recipe-p2's rule; the felt claim itself is for the reader, and no agent heard it. Proposed: drop "or p3" until recipe-p3's Method can make a loop without a mirror.

Built as written (keep the hit, silence its reflection), all 448 breaks lose the 8|9 mirror. But 16 of 448 land on a new mirror, through one of their own steps. Examples: 1 2 3 15 16 (through steps 1 and 9) and 2 4 6 11 13 (through 4 and 12). In those, the break moves the centre and doesn't remove it, so "the bilateral symmetry breaks" holds for 432. Proposed after that clause: "(about 8|9; a few breaks land on a new mirror through one of their steps, and keep their balance about it)".

pieces.title: the mirror, heard blind · four steps
pieces.caption: **Is the mirror stiller, by ear?** Write a half in steps 1 to 8 and mirror it at 17 − n, as the Method says. On a loop that mirror has two ends, 8|9 and 16|1, so the Ingredients' "mirror at the start" is the same one. Beside it, the same half under recipe-p2's rule, played twice: the page's own "than p2". The test, last, blind, with its rule set before the first trial: 8 trials, a fresh half each time, the order a coin; 7 or 8 mirror picks (3.5% by guessing) reads the page's way, 0 or 1 reads it backwards. The page above says which should be stiller, so for a reading without that leak, hand it to someone who hasn't read the recipe. Checked in Node on the piece's own engine (workshop/rich-checks.mjs, all PASS); no agent can hear a mix, so how it sounds was not heard.
